title_en: Use MapGenie's Mortal Shell 2 Map to Track Essential Locations and Items - IGN
body_en:
On the IGN side, our Mortal Shell II wiki is here to help with burning questions you may have on your journey across Fallgrim.
Our coverage includes:
Meg Koepp is a Guides Editor on the IGN Guides team. When she's not working, you can find her trying to win Victory Royales in Fortnite or tinkering with her AYN Thor.
